modelDescription: The Howa 1500 Super Deluxe walnut features a walnut stock with forend and grip caps; threaded barrel; machined receiver and forged bolt; large internal bolt handle and pressure vent holes; bolt faces are true and square to chamber; tool-less firing pin removal; Two Stage Match trigger; 3 Position Safety SUB MOA 3 shot group @ 100 yds with premium factory ammo.
